decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.The single storey rear extension shall be rendered to match the existing house.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is occupied.
Condition : 5 - The extension [building] hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 11A Lampton Avenue.

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the western or eastern walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Demolition of existing conservatory and erection of part two storey side and rear extension, single storey side and rear extension and rear roof extension to dwellinghouse
